name: What technology is used for virtual home tours?

mainEntity.name: What technology is used for virtual home tours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virtual home tours commonly use 3D walkthroughs, live video calls with an agent, and high-quality photo galleries. Platforms like Matterport create immersive 3D models, allowing you to navigate a property as if you were there. Our agents can conduct personalized video tours through platforms like Zoom or FaceTime, providing real-time commentary and answering your questions as they walk through homes in locations such as Palm Beach or Orange County.
acceptedAnswer.description: Technology for virtual tours includes 3D walkthroughs (e.g., Matterport), live video calls with an agent, and extensive photo galleries for remote property viewing.
